questions.stem: What causes muscle fatigue during intense exercise?

options.text: Carbon dioxide dissolving in the blood
Too much oxygen reaching the muscles
A build-up of lactic acid in the muscles
A build-up of ethanol in the muscles

questions.explanation: During intense exercise, lactic acid accumulates in the muscles from anaerobic respiration. This build-up causes pain, a burning sensation, and reduces muscle efficiency, leading to fatigue.
